newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DMCI plans 2.4 mln preferred shares offer.
newsitem.headline: DMCI plans 2.4 mln preferred shares offer.

text.p: DMCI Holdings Inc of the Philippines sought Securities and Exchange Commision (SEC) approval on Tuesday for the issue of up to 2.4 milllion convertible preferred shares.

Documents submitted to the SEC showed that the preferred shares will be offered at an issue price of 1,000 pesos per share, convertible into common shares at between a 10 to 15 percent conversion premium.
DMCI seeks to offer a minimum of one million shares.
Proceeds of the offer ranging from 970 million pesos to 2.33 billion pesos will be used for equity investments in real estate projects, documents said.
PCI Capital was chosen as underwriter for the offer.
